english.title: Contravene tree preservation orders by damage / topping / lopping of tree in manner likely to destroy it - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), contravened the provisions of a tree preservation order, namely **(..SPECIFY ORDER..), by wilfully damaging, topping or lopping a tree at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) in such a manner as to be likely to destroy it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 210(1)(b) and (2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
